summary: Starfish Pinball Panic is an underwater pinball game where a purple octopus works the flippers, the shell drifts with the current, and every starfish you light spins and crawls one step closer to the drain. Play with Left/Right or A/D to flip, hold and release Space to launch, tap Space in flight for a bubble boost, light all eight starfish across your three shells, then sink the shell into the glowing X pocket to find the treasure.
